citations.shading_check: Figure 10 rendered at 135dpi and inspected (alwen2020-33.png). Its red boxes are hyperref link borders, not semantic shading. The check was owed because Figs. 2-4 and Fig. 9 of the same paper are genuinely shading-coded.
citations.defect_finding: Figure 10's Propose asserts valid-spk(id, spk) and reports (exposed, id, spk) to F_AS, and spk is never bound in that operation -- Propose takes only act, and the only key-like value in scope is spk_t, returned by the adversary. The main-body Figure 2 (p. 13) has no such line and receives spk_t only in the add case, so the two figures disagree. Transcribed as printed (lines 14 and 22, both marked in the box) because there is no unique repair: reading it as spk_t makes the up-spk branch assert validity of a key the adversary chose, which is a different functionality.
citations.paging: PDF page and printed folio agree throughout.
